steps.caption: GMB Ranking Grid
steps.narration: This is the GMB Ranking Grid. It searches from a grid of points across your area and shows your rank at each one.

steps.caption: Find your business
steps.narration: Find your business by name or address, or paste its Google Maps link.

steps.caption: The phrase a customer searches
steps.narration: Type the phrase a customer would search for, such as roofing contractor.

steps.caption: Advanced: grid size and spacing
steps.narration: Open Advanced to pick a grid from three by three up to fifteen by fifteen, and the spacing.

steps.caption: Scan history
steps.narration: Start ranking scan runs it, and finished scans wait in Scan history. This one is a seven by seven grid for roofing contractor.

steps.caption: The scan details and the grid
steps.narration: The report opens with the business, the keyword and the grid size, and the points on the right.

steps.caption: Your rank at each point
steps.narration: Each point is your rank from that spot. Green is the top three, yellow four to ten, red eleven to twenty.

steps.caption: Hover a point for the top results there
steps.narration: Hover a point to see who came up at the top there.

steps.caption: Rank summary
steps.narration: Rank summary gives the average and best rank, and how many points landed in the top three.

steps.caption: Rank distribution
steps.narration: Rank distribution shows the share of points in each band.

steps.caption: Top competitors across the grid
steps.narration: Top competitors lists the businesses found most often across the grid, with their best rank.

steps.caption: Print / PDF
steps.narration: Print or PDF turns the report into a file for a client or your records.

steps.caption: Menu: GMB Ranking Grid
steps.narration: You'll find the GMB Ranking Grid in the menu on the left, under Google Business.

youtube.title: GMB Ranking Grid in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of the GMB Ranking Grid in ConstructHUB: find your business, enter the phrase a customer searches, size the grid, then read a finished scan: your rank at every point, the summary, the distribution and the businesses found most often across the grid.
